name: tagore-monorepo
description: Tagore: AI-written release notes from git tags, published to GitHub Releases, Docker builds, S3 and an in-app What's New dialog.

scripts.build: npm run build -w tagore && npm run build -w @tagore/whats-new && npm run bundle && npm run schema
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w tagore && npm run typecheck -w @tagore/whats-new
scripts.check-dist: npm run bundle && npm run schema && git diff --exit-code -- dist schema
